details:
Look I know that there is a Social tab that was already requested back in 2019, but I want to feed this back myself, because I want to tell you why a refresh tab is necessary.

1. The tab is going to be very useful for people that don't have the best internet or throttles. Some people that have higher ping, low bandwidth or low speeds are suffering the most from this. This causes people to refresh instances by restarting the game more then they would like.

2. Long time user usage. People that use the game for more then a short period of time will encounter a side effect where socials won't refresh automatically even if they move worlds. This will be good for Long VRChat gaming sessions, Events, Sleep sessions and anything that requires people to be in more then a few hours.

3. VRCX having a friends refresh tab. They use your VRChat API to do so. Adding the friends refresh tab natively will be good for people who are not really fond of downloading third party software's like VRCX, and people that has devices including but not limited to: ANDROID, IOS, QUEST ect who do not have/want access to VRCX or don't have a PC.

4. It will help when automatic refresh just stops working especially in some VRChat updates. When the API breaks for a split second, sometimes a manual refresh click can help bring the API for the socials back to normal.

Since the Menu UI change back in 2022, there has probably been changes to the coding over the last 4 years. However, hopefully we can get this feature sooner rather then later because had been mentioned a lot by people in the past, and hopefully you will all get around to it when it comes.
title: Social Refresh Tab 2026 Request
